attributes.name: Shaija
attributes.powers:
Damage dealt by Shaija is dealt to each character at your location.

Before you act, examine the top card of your deck. If that card has the Attack, Melee, or Ranged trait, discard it; otherwise, recharge it.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.
